subject: Recap: Hosted API usage profile + $/1M token target — confirmation needed
preview_text: Confirming the monthly token band and peak TPS so we can lock in the committed pricing band and next steps for legal/PO.
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Avery Jones <avery@inventalabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Hosted API usage profile + $/1M token target — confirmation needed

Hi Avery — great to meet today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size pricing and SLA correctly:

Summary from call:
- Primary product: customer support assistant (NLP + summarization + reranking).
- Expected ramp: pilot month -> small cohort; target production in 6 weeks.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms median gen latency for single-turn queries, and strict data retention requirements (30 days).

Pricing qual asks (please confirm):
1) Monthly tokens: can you confirm the expected committed band for first 3 months? From our convo it sounded like 30–50M tokens/month initially.
2) Peak TPS: you mentioned spikes during support surges — can you confirm peak concurrent TPS we should plan for? I heard ~100–140 TPS but want exact peak.
3) Budget target: you said you were aiming for ~$900 per 1M tokens as a target. Is that your procurement target or a hard ceiling?

Options we can offer from hosted API:
- Committed band (6-month): ~$850 per 1M tokens for >=30M/mo commit + SLA and reserved capacity for peaks.
- Flex/On-demand: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens, no commit (handles burst automatically but higher unit cost).

Next steps
- Can you confirm items 1–3 above by EOD Monday?
- If commit looks feasible, I’ll share a two-tier estimate and loop in Legal/Procurement for an MSA and PO cadence.

Attachments: I’ll produce an updated estimate once you confirm the numbers.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Avery Jones <avery@inventalabs.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@inventalabs.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Hosted API usage profile + $/1M token target — confirmation needed

Thanks Lauren — nice summary. Confirming on our end: 

1) Monthly tokens: Pilot month ~35M tokens, then production month ~60M tokens; we expect to average ~80M tokens/month by Q1 (growth from feature rollouts). For the first 3 months we can commit to 30–60M/mo depending on final pricing.

2) Peak TPS: We see brief spikes in webchat around product launches. Peak observed in our load tests is ~130 TPS sustained for ~3–5 minutes, with rolling peaks up to 180 TPS for under a minute. Baseline query TPS during business hours ~18–25 TPS.

3) Budget target: Procurement is pushing for a target unit cost of $800–$950 per 1M tokens. $900 is the sweet spot. They’re open to a committed band if it hits that range and we get predictability on burst handling and SLA.

I attached our traffic profile workbook (Inventa_Traffic_Profile.xlsx) that shows hourly distribution and expected monthly mix. Also, we will need simple answers on retention controls and audit logs (SOC2 type) — can you copy your security contact?

Avery Jones
Head of Product, Inventa Labs
avery@inventalabs.com

Attachment: Inventa_Traffic_Profile.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Avery Jones <avery@inventalabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Hosted API usage profile + $/1M token target — confirmation needed

Thanks for the details, Avery — the traffic workbook is super helpful. Based on the numbers you sent and the peak profile, here are two practical offers we can move forward with immediately:

Option A — Committed (recommended if you want unit-econ predictability):
- Commitment: 6 months at 30M baseline tokens/month (scale tiers available).
- Unit price: $850 per 1M tokens for committed usage.
- Peak handling: reserved capacity to cover sustained peaks up to 150 TPS; short bursts above reserved capacity will be handled via autoscaling credits.
- SLA: 99.9% availability for inference endpoints, standard incident reporting, SOC 2 Type II evidence on request.

Option B — Flex/No-commit (fastest launch):
- No upfront commit.
- Unit price: $1,100 per 1M tokens.
- Peak handling: platform autoscaling with possible throttling at very large bursts (we’ll surface early warnings to your team).

Notes/assumptions:
- The $850 band assumes a signed MSA and a committed billing cadence (monthly invoices).
- If you need guaranteed coverage for those very short sub-minute spikes to 180 TPS, we can add a small burst-reserve add-on; I’ve priced that into the attached estimate.

I attached an updated estimate (Redwood_Estimate_v2.pdf) that shows modeled invoices for 35M, 60M, and 120M monthly usage and the monthly cost delta between options A and B.

Can you confirm: (a) which option you prefer, (b) if procurement will require a formal PO/MSA to hit the $850 band, and (c) whether your security team needs the SOC2 pack before contract signature?

If it helps, Marcus (copied) can sign off on a small introductory discount to bridge negotiation. Stephanie will coordinate a brief capacity validation exercise (30–60 minute run) with your infra team to validate peak TPS handling.

Thanks — I’ll keep the calendar open for a quick follow up after you confirm.

— Lauren
Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Jones <avery@inventalabs.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Hosted API usage profile + $/1M token target — confirmation needed

Forwarding Lauren’s note and estimate — quick internal note: happy to approve an introductory concession to move the first 2 months to $825 per 1M (if they commit to 6 months and sign MSA within 30 days).

Avery — happy to jump on a call with procurement/legal to speed MSA / PO. Stephanie, please schedule the capacity validation (DevOps sync) and send runbook.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
